shared.drop_box_note: Document drop boxes are outside every location, so you can submit paperwork without waiting in line.

appeals._purpose: Used by the 'How to appeal' section of Notice Detail. This is the highest-stakes data in the file.
appeals.how: Instructions are printed on the back of the Notice of Action itself. Fill out the back of the notice and send or take it to the Appeals Unit.

appeals_unit.name: Appeals Unit, County of Santa Clara Social Services

appeals.ombuds_note: Before filing a hearing you can ask your worker, then a supervisor, then request a free confidential case review from the County Ombuds office.

windows._purpose: The two appeal clocks. They are DIFFERENT DEADLINES and the app must never merge them or describe one using the other's number. This is the highest-stakes data in Carta.

aid_paid_pending.en: Ask for a state hearing within 10 days of the date on the notice and your CalFresh stays at the same amount until a judge decides.
aid_paid_pending.es: Pida una audiencia estatal dentro de los 10 días de la fecha del aviso y su CalFresh se mantiene en la misma cantidad hasta que un juez decida.
aid_paid_pending.what_it_is: Continuing benefits while waiting for a fair hearing. Requesting the hearing inside this window keeps benefits at the current amount until the ALJ rules -- it does not decide the appeal.

hearing_request.en: You have 90 days from the date on the notice to ask for a state hearing at all.
hearing_request.es: Tiene 90 días desde la fecha del aviso para pedir una audiencia estatal.
hearing_request.what_it_is: The deadline to request a hearing. Missing the 10-day window does NOT end the right to a hearing -- it only ends continuing benefits while it is pending.

windows._do_not_conflate: 10 days keeps benefits running. 90 days is how long the right to a hearing lasts. Telling a household '90 days' when they are deciding whether to file this week would cost them their benefits during the appeal; telling them '10 days' after day 11 would make them think they had lost a right they still have.
windows.source_name: Legal Services of Northern California, LSNC Guide to CalFresh Benefits -- 'Continuing benefits while waiting for a fair hearing'
windows.disclaimer_required: Confirm with your county -- this is not legal advice.

what_to_bring._purpose: Rendered from the active notice's checklist, not hardcoded. This is the fallback list when no checklist exists.
always: The notice itself, or a photo of it
usually: Pay stubs from the last 30 days
Proof of where you live (lease or a utility bill)
Social Security numbers for everyone in the household
what_to_bring._freshness_purpose: How recent a document has to be, for the Vault's staleness warning. Keyed on a doc_types.json id. THIS IS THE ONLY PLACE SUCH A RULE MAY LIVE, and every entry carries its own source: CLAUDE.md section 16 forbids inventing a rule about what a programme requires, and 'most offices want the last 30 days' is exactly such a rule. doc_types.json must stay a vocabulary and must never grow this. A document type with no entry here gets its age shown and NO claim about whether that age is a problem.

pay_stub.en: Most offices want pay stubs from the last 30 days.
pay_stub.es: La mayoría de las oficinas piden talones de pago de los últimos 30 días.
pay_stub.TODO_verify: Santa Clara County's own 'what to bring' guidance says 'Pay stubs from the last 30 days'. Confirm that wording at the county source and check whether it applies to CalFresh recertification specifically or only to a new application, before this ships.

what_to_bring._freshness_removed: bank_statement (60 days) was removed 2026-08-25. It was confidence:low and its own TODO_verify said it was NOT SOURCED at the agency -- a plausible convention rather than a rule with a citation. CLAUDE.md section 16 does not allow a low-confidence claim about what an agency requires, so the choice was cite it or delete it, and there was no source to cite. Consequence, and it is the correct one: a bank statement in the Vault now shows its age with NO claim about whether that age is a problem. Restore it only WITH a citation.
